prompt: Compute the sum of [3,5,8]. Return only JSON with the key value.
Merge closed intervals [[1,4],[2,6],[8,10],[10,12]], including intervals that touch. Return only JSON with the key intervals and the sorted merged intervals.

Simulate a ledger starting at balance 100. Process events in order: (a,debit,70),(b,debit,50),(a,debit,70),(c,credit,40),(b,debit,50),(d,credit,15). Apply each event ID at most once. Reject a debit if funds are insufficient; rejected IDs are NOT remembered and can be retried. Count duplicates only for IDs already applied. Return only JSON with balance, applied (IDs in application order), duplicates and rejected (number of rejected attempts).
Deduplicate [7,2,7,-1,2,0] and sort ascending. Return only JSON with the key values.

Find parallel execution layers for tasks with dependencies A:[], B:[A], C:[A], D:[B,C]. Tasks in a layer may run only after previous layers. Sort task IDs within each layer. Return only JSON with the key layers.

Simulate a cache where a key is absent when current time >= set_time+TTL. Operations: at t=0 set a=1 TTL=5; at t=4 get a; at t=4 set b=2 TTL=3; at t=5 get a; at t=5 set a=3 TTL=2; at t=6 get b; at t=7 get a; at t=7 get b. Missing reads return null. Return only JSON with reads (values in read order) and live_keys (sorted keys still live at t=7).
Count each whitespace-separated word in red blue red green blue red. Return only a JSON object mapping each word to its count.

Rows have (id,time): (1,2),(2,1),(3,2),(4,3). Sort by time descending, then id descending. For the page after cursor (id=3,time=2), include only rows strictly after that cursor in this order and take at most two. Return only JSON with ids in page order.

Start in pending. Allowed actions are authorize: pending->authorized, capture: authorized->captured, refund: captured->refunded. Process (e1,authorize),(e2,refund),(e3,capture),(e2,refund),(e3,capture),(e4,capture). Remember IDs only after valid actions; a remembered ID is a duplicate and makes no transition. Count invalid attempts separately. Return only JSON with state, accepted (IDs in acceptance order), invalid and duplicates.
